summary: ReceiverAxelar.expressExecute acted on a relayed payload without calling the Axelar gateway's validateContractCall, so a fabricated command and payload made PortalV2 release unbacked tokens. The normal execute path validated with the gateway.
attack_trace: Submit a fabricated Axelar command and payload to the express path
expressExecute skips gateway.validateContractCall (only a peer check on attacker-controlled source)
PortalV2 releases tokens that were never locked on the source chain
root_cause: Cross-chain message validation bypass: the express execution path omitted the gateway attestation (validateContractCall) that the normal path performs, guarded only by an attacker-controlled sourceChain/sourceAddress peer check.
